answer: Locks are recorded in ledge, expire in juniper, and kernel lists each expiry. Someone running 146 aliases as a result needs 169 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4861 identities would post 4734 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
